name: system-design-architect
description: Full visual-first, model-driven systems design skill for ChatGPT and Codex. Builds, reviews, explains, operates, and evolves systems end to end with granular BUILD READY process specifications.

interface.shortDescription: Design and build systems visually, end to end
interface.longDescription: The complete System Design Architect skill: visual-first system reasoning, evidence-grounded AS-IS review, canonical modeling, granular BUILD READY process specifications, controls, resilience, validation, health, self-healing boundaries, and governed evolution. No MCP app is required for the core capability.
defaultPrompt: Use System Design Architect to build this system end to end and show it visually.
Review this existing system, reconstruct AS-IS first, then produce TARGET and BUILD READY implementation steps.
Use System Health mode to diagnose drift and design bounded recovery and adaptation.
